DRAMA.gloss: a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage
DRAMA.definition: A dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage.
DRAMA.example: He wrote several plays but only one was produced on Broadway.

MARA.gloss: hare-like rodent of the pampas of Argentina
MARA.definition: Hare-like rodent of the pampas of Argentina.

SAD.gloss: experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness
SAD.definition: Experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness.
SAD.example: Feeling sad because his dog had died.

MAD.example: Stayed huffy a good while"- Mark Twain.

ARM.definition: A human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb.

RAM.gloss: strike or drive against with a heavy impact
RAM.definition: Strike or drive against with a heavy impact.
RAM.example: Ram the gate with a sledgehammer.

DAM.gloss: a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea
DAM.definition: A barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea.

DAS.definition: Any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and feet with hooflike toes.

DRAM.definition: A unit of apothecary weight equal to an eighth of an ounce or to 60 grains.
